title: the commons root has one resolver, and the installer survives its absence
intention: Every production default for the commons root comes from cairn.tools.base.address (ROOTS['commons']), and installer.install over an absent commons returns a named failed result instead of raising.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: six production sites default to ~/dev/src/CairnCommons (git grep over dev/src and the Path.home() / dev / src form); about 35 sites inline the sibling form; address.py already holds ROOTS['commons']
traces_to: Law 1: one resolver for a settled answer, not six hand-built; Law 7: an absent commons is a named result, not a traceback; CP4.
how: Replace the six home-relative defaults with address.ROOTS['commons'] while keeping each site's existing env override (CAIRN_COMMONS_ROOT, CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS); make install() return a failed result naming the missing intentions directory. Red-first proof. The 35 sibling-form copies are bounded out and counted.

clauses.claim: no production .py file outside proofs and probes spells the home-relative commons path (git grep finds none)
each of the six sites yields address.ROOTS['commons'] when no override is set, and still honours CAIRN_COMMONS_ROOT where it did
installer.install(intentions_dir=<absent dir>, dry_run=True) returns a failed result naming that path and raises nothing

decisions.text: D1: the fix at cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py, cairn/tools/ticket_inspector/inspector.py, cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py, cairn/machines/skill_block/skill_block.py, cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py
D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: six production sites default to ~/dev/src/CairnCommons (git grep over dev/src and the Path.home() / dev / src form); about 35 sites inline the sibling form; address.py already holds ROOTS['commons']
measured.how: git grep -nE over *.py outside proofs and probes

measured.saw: installer.install -> gather_host_seams(d) -> d.iterdir() with no existence check, so an absent directory raises FileNotFoundError
measured.how: read installer.py lines 24-30 and 312-313 (the dry run itself not executed: HYPOTHESIS that this is the crash the orchestrator saw)
